title: Commit the DOTNET_STARTUP_HOOKS driver validate used, with stop, throw and close modes, under tests/window
how_to_read: Each attempt is one line and a `details` filename in this same directory. Open a detail file ONLY when this index points you at one -- the summaries are here so you do not have to. `caused_by` is what sent the stage back; `changed` is what the attempt then touched, counted by kind. Several attempts in a row that were caused by the same stage and changed no `src` is a loop, not progress.

open.issue: A startup-hook driver is committed in the repo under tests/window (source or project, loadable via DOTNET_STARTUP_HOOKS): missing
The driver has a stop mode that clicks Stop (calls MainWindow.OnCancel on the dispatcher) via FSA_HOOK_MODE=stop: missing
The driver has a throw mode (FSA_HOOK_MODE=throw) that raises an unhandled exception on the dispatcher: missing
The driver has a close mode (FSA_HOOK_MODE=close) that closes the window before the first ending: missing
A committed C-006 case reads the Stopped ending (criterion 6) through the hook: missing
A committed C-012 case covers the exit-70 path (criterion 12) through the hook: missing
A committed test covers O-016, the window closed before the first ending in report mode: missing
The hook is built or supplied by the committed test itself rather than left in validate's %TEMP% (implied by 'the next validate must rebuild it'): missing
stop-close-modes-same-ending-every-run: Close: exit 70, 0/40 reports; stop: 40/40 Stopped, schema 1 (exe rebuilt, none published)

in-process-click-respects-disabled-and-hidden: needs first: The committed stop mode has to check the control's state itself before it clicks: refuse when CancelButton.IsEnabled or IsVisible is false, so the C-006 case fails against a disabled or …
throw-mode-exit-70-comes-from-the-app: Own-built exe+hook: 10/10 exit 70, handler removed 3/3 0xE0434352; but 70 leaves no report

Mutation proofs live in validate's record (scratch copies, nothing committed) rather than in a committed script that applies the disabled, collapsed, handler-removed and Exit-rule-removed mutants. That is cheaper now, but it leaves the fail-ability proof outside the repo, which is the shape this slice exists to fix.
One Pressable gate on CancelButton for all three modes, even though throw does not logically need Stop. Per-mode triggers would be more precise. One gate is simpler and puts every fault mid-scan.
The closed-early case is named O-016 (an obligation) beside C-xxx criteria, and the hook project is FsaWindowHook under tests/window, not tests/window/hook. Both are naming and placement.
The hook reports through a text log file (FSA_HOOK_LOG). Stdout and a named event are the alternatives; the exe is WinExe with no console, which is why a file was chosen.
The inert-host assertion lives as a first step inside Test-C006, not as its own case ID.
